messages.content: Skeptical ICLR area chair and world-model security researcher. Do not reward a catchy name or a generic delay attack. Return JSON only.

{"candidate": {"one_sentence_claim": "Latent safety filters can be defeated by an executable action-timing/phase attack: a physically valid change in command cadence or observation delay keeps rendered observations and ensemble disagreement apparently normal, but shifts the world model one-step operator relative to the safety value function, causing confident safety decisions to flip before residual calibration reacts.", "mechanism": "The filter learns a safety HJ value on a fixed temporal abstraction dt; action timing/latency changes the effective transition operator. The encoder and ensemble see the same delayed/aliased observation stream, so epistemic disagreement and value-target residual stay low, while the safety value is evaluated on a phase-shifted latent state.", "attacker": "Can control command timing, packet batching, or induce bounded observation delay; no weight/gradient access. Actions remain physically executable.", "carrier": "public latent-safety/DINO-WM code (Dubins and Franka latent safety filter) or DreamerV3; short synthetic Dubins pilot then public code.", "repair": "phase-aware transition model / timestamp-conditioned latent dynamics plus conformal calibration on timing perturbations.", "evidence_status": "no experiment yet; candidate only"}, "prior_art": ["Attacking the Trusted Imagination arXiv:2606.22966 white-box latent imagination corruption", "When World Models Lie arXiv:2609.34300 adaptive conformal safety under temporal abstraction mismatch and observation staleness", "UNISafe arXiv:2505.00779 OOD uncertainty filter", "generic sensor delay and sim-to-real timing mismatch"], "questions": ["Is the security mechanism distinct enough for novelty >=7?", "Does the attacker create a world-model-specific failure beyond generic delay/covariate shift?", "What exact short pilot can distinguish it and what falsifies it?", "If reject, propose one stronger candidate involving safety-oracle/world-model composition that is not prior art. Return strict JSON."]}
